content: Root cause: The bug in the BlendedInfixSuggester was caused by the incorrect multiplication of the requested number of suggestions (`num`) by a factor (`numFactor`) in multiple lookup methods. This led to the suggester returning more results than requested, as the multiplication was applied at multiple points in the call chain instead of just once at the final lookup call. The patch corrected this by ensuring that the multiplication only occurs in the last method in the lookup chain, thus returning the correct number of results as intended.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: return super.lookup(key, contexts, onlyMorePopular, num * numFactor);
return super.lookup(key, contexts, num * numFactor, allTermsRequired, doHighlight);
return super.lookup(key, contextInfo, num * numFactor, allTermsRequired, doHighlight);
